messages:
anya: Quick sanity check: new reranker v2 on search-bench shows +1.8 NDCG@10 but -2.2 MRR@1 on tail queries. Anyone else see this pattern?

devon: Hmm same here locally when I ran PTQ-int8. MRR hit on short-answer queries. Could be candidate ordering or priming.

samir: @anya can you dump a failing example? Also which dataset split (holdout vs online)?

anya: holdout. here's a compact repro (one query):
```
query: "how to reset password"
cands: ["Reset via profile settings", "Contact support to reset password", "Password reset link expired", "Use 2FA to recover"]
float32 scores: [0.72, 0.68, 0.65, 0.12]
int8 (ptq) scores: [0.68, 0.71, 0.63, 0.09]
```
notice swap between first two candidates -> MRR down.

devon: maybe calibration shift due to embedding scale? Did you run embed-rescale step? Also check tokenization differences (HTML vs text) — we had a prior bug.

mike: Run quick eval on same sample but with canonicalized doc text (strip tags, normalize whitespace) and calc NDCG/MRR. If swap persists, try re-scoring with fp16 and int8 to isolate quant error.

eval-bot: automated run finished: float32 NDCG@10=0.744 MRR@1=0.582; int8 NDCG@10=0.761 MRR@1=0.558 ; delta_ndcg=+0.017 delta_mrr=-0.024

samir: Interesting — ndcg up, mrr down. Could be head vs tail tradeoff. Let's run stratified slices (short-answer vs longform). I'll queue a job.

anya: queued the stratified eval: job=job_1767894321_slices

devon: while that runs, small checklist:
- confirm tokenizer parity between offline eval and prod
- rerun PTQ with calibration set sampled from tail queries
- check candidate dedupe/order stability in preproc

mike: +1 to sampled calibration and to include candidate ids in score output for deterministic tiebreak.

anya: thx team. if slice shows MRR drop concentrated on short-answer queries, we'll try candidate-level temperature scaling as mitigation and retest.

samir: ping me when stratified results land, will coordinate a quick canary test.

anya: will do :thumbsup:
